title: Keyless Trolling Script Universal
features:
•  Aimbot — Camera/mouse aim with FOV, prediction, target priority, and triggerbot
•  Silent Aim — Redirect bullets without moving crosshair, with prediction and wall check
•  Hitbox Expander — Enlarge player hitboxes for easier targeting
•  ESP Boxes — 2D/3D player boxes with team/enemy colors
•  ESP Skeleton — Draw player skeletons for visibility
•  ESP Info — Show names, distance, health, weapon, and head dot
•  Chams — Highlight players through walls with custom colors
•  Tracers & Snaplines — Lines from crosshair or screen to players
•  FOV Circle — Visual field-of-view indicator with adjustable radius
•  Radar — 2D mini-map showing nearby players
•  Fly — Smooth free-flight movement with speed control
•  Noclip — Pass through walls and objects
•  Infinite Jump — Jump repeatedly without cooldown
•  Speed Hack — Adjustable walk/run speed
•  Jump Boost — Increase jump height/power
•  Teleport — Click-to-teleport, to players, or custom spawn
•  Kill Aura — Auto-attack players within range
•  Anti-Fling — Prevent being thrown or magneted
•  God Mode — Basic damage/invulnerability (where supported)
•  Anti-Aim — Spinbot or velocity spoof for evasion
•  Server Hop — Rejoin or switch to low-ping servers
•  Auto Rejoin — Reconnect on kick or disconnect
•  Team Check — Whitelist/ignore teammates in features
•  Visible Check — Only target or highlight visible enemies
•  Config System — Save/load settings and keybinds
•  Performance Toggle — Distance limits and on/off switches for all modules
•  Fake Lag — Simulate lag on yourself to troll chasers
•  Spin Bot — Constantly spin your character to annoy others
•  Annoy Mode — Orbit or rapidly teleport around a targeted player
•  Force Chat — Make targeted players say custom messages (if possible)
•  Sit Spam — Force sitting animation spam on yourself or others
•  Attach to Player — Stick to another player’s head/feet for trolling
•  View Player — Force camera to another player’s perspective
•  Fake Death — Pretend to die or ragdoll dramatically
•  Name Spoof — Change displayed name or impersonate others
•  Sound Spam — Play loud or annoying sounds near players
•  Particle Troll — Spam effects/particles on targeted players
•  Server Message Troll — Broadcast fake announcements (where exploitable)
